name: Mephenoxalone
summary: Mephenoxalone (trade names Dorsiflex, Moderamin, Control-OM) is a muscle relaxant and mild anxiolytic. It inhibits neuron transmission, relaxing skeletal muscles by inhibiting the reflex arc. As the effect of muscle relaxation, mephenoxalone affects mental condition, and is also a treatment for nervousness and anxiety.

pharmacology.text: It inhibits neuron transmission, relaxing skeletal muscles by inhibiting the reflex arc.

uses.text: As the effect of muscle relaxation, mephenoxalone affects mental condition, and is also a treatment for nervousness and anxiety.

fact.en: Mephenoxalone is an oxazolidinone and has almost the same structure as the muscle relaxant metaxalone, differing only in the groups on its benzene ring.
fact.zh: Mephenoxalone 屬於噁唑烷酮類，結構與肌肉鬆弛劑美他沙酮幾乎相同，只差在苯環上的取代基。
